//: Configuration for the /sdd-from-notion bridge skill. No secrets live here: Notion access uses the Notion MCP OAuth session stored by the Devin CLI, not this file.
//backlogPageUrl: The Notion page that holds the sequential TUDOLAR backlog. Tasks are '### Tnn - Title' headings in the page body, each with its own acceptance criteria.
//changeIdPrefix: Prefix for derived OpenSpec change ids. The task number is appended, e.g. t03-integrate-prisma.
//sddMarker: Line the skill writes directly under a task heading to record its SDD state. Used to detect an existing marker so re-runs update instead of duplicating.
//doneMarker: The handoff convention marks a task Done in the backlog. A task whose predecessor is not Done is not eligible.
//statuses: Status labels the skill writes into the SDD marker line.
